displayProperties.description:
Training 1 of 7

Apply Boons and Banes and complete objectives to increase your reward multiplier and your score!

Complete the activity with a high enough score to earn an A-Grade Reward Packageto continue on.
displayProperties.name: Training (1/7)

displayProperties.description:
Training 2 of 7

Apply Challenges to increase your reward multiplier further.

Complete the activity with a high enough score to earn an A-Grade Reward Package to continue on.
displayProperties.name: Training (2/7)

displayProperties.description:
Training 3 of 7

Beat the clock to increase your score! The more time left on the clock at the end, the higher your Score Bonus. 

Complete the activity with a high enough time bonus to earn an A-Grade Reward Package and earn some  Bonus Drops on other Portal activities to continue on.
displayProperties.name: Training (3/7)

displayProperties.description:
Training 4 of 7

Use Challenges to increase the Power of the activity and increase the reward multiplier further.

Earn an A-Grade Reward Package to continue on.
displayProperties.name: Training (4/7)

displayProperties.description:
Training 5 of 7

Increase your reward multiplier with higher Power equipment.

Earn an A-Grade Reward Package to continue on.
displayProperties.name: Training (5/7)

displayProperties.description:
Training 6 of 7

Use Player Stakes to put yourself at a disadvantage but greatly increase your reward multiplier.

Equip the Avant-Garde Player Stake, then earn an A-Grade Reward Package to continue on.
displayProperties.name: Training (6/7)

displayProperties.description:
Training 7 of 7

Prove you have what it takes to stand shoulder to shoulder with other Guardians. 

Equip the No HUD Player Stake, then earn an A-Grade Reward Package to complete your Portal Training!
displayProperties.name: Training (7/7)
